home.text: Hello, My name is Yakubenka Ivan. And this is myself presentation project. I have education as engineer of radio electronic. I started learning programming in college from assembler and C. Then I interested web technology and started study php which was popular. For php I needed to known html and I had learned it and created first pages. But it looked so bad and I had to learn css and js too. Having this knowledge, I thought I am well and send resume for a job as js developer. Tested task was easy but interview was on English and that was not easy, I failed. But I made conclusions and started study English harder. I had heard about java course in EPAM and send resume to it. I passed on second time. I done well first part courses which was online and wait invite to offline part, I needed relocate for it, but  invite delayed and I made decision stay in my position. After 2 years my company was finding front-end developer and I was hired. That project used .Net Framework and I success took 2 courses .net. But after 2 months team has been made decision migrate project from web to desktop app.  I thought I needed up my skils and started develop one of my project from courses. That project registredmy contracts, payrolls and bonuses. After fired out I made some rest and then make decision that I want write full site. I started rewrite random site by react and after some time I get proposition from friend to make site for her.  I wrote it by figma layout and deployed on hosting. Gusmaryhair site was online half year and owner decided not prolongation hosting. Now I have some contracts for maitanance and for automatization calculation and registration I write one more service.
